egress.enforcement: nftables table inet pa3b_egress_off, created as root in the root network namespace of the WSL2 virtual machine that the Linux proving host (Ubuntu 24.04) shares with every other WSL2 distribution on this machine and with Docker Desktop's engine: output hook (priority -10) first refuses every packet to the WSL DNS-tunnelling resolver 10.255.255.254 (an address on lo that proxies to the Windows host; TCP by tcp reset, the rest by ICMP port-unreachable), then accepts packets to the host's own addresses only (fib daddr type local: 127.0.0.0/8, ::1 and its eth0 address, which never leave the VM and carry the kernel's own reset and ICMP answers back to the refusing socket), then refuses every other packet the host originates (TCP by tcp reset, UDP by ICMP port-unreachable, the rest by ICMP admin-prohibited); forward hook (priority -10, policy drop) refuses every forwarded packet the same way (the local Docker Engine's bridge docker0, so every container, the gnark container included); input hook drops every packet a container sends to the host (iifname docker0), so a container cannot reach the host's resolver either; the docker endpoint is the local engine's unix:///var/run/docker.sock (Ubuntu docker.io 29.1.3 running in this distribution, no Docker Desktop integration); the table was created before the before-probes and deleted after the after-probes, no Windows-side rule was used, and nothing was pulled, downloaded or installed while it existed; rehearsed before the run with the same probes from the host and from a container (all refused) and after its removal (all resolved and connected)

establishes: one real Groth16 proof of the designated program was made on this host through the archive-only gate from the committed verified archive, with the digest-pinned gnark image, SP1_PROVER=cpu and network egress refused before and after the run, and the designated verifier (the CREATE2-authenticated v6.1.0 runtime) accepted it and refused its tampered copy; its wall time and peak memory are recorded against the 2-day rotation delay: liveness of the self-hosted path on this hardware, at this time
doesNotEstablish: the provenance of the proving: the verifier proves the proof's validity under the designated key, never that it was made through the gate, with SP1_PROVER=cpu, with egress refused, by this host binary, in this time or with this memory; those facts are the operator's observation, bound as far as the repository can bind them (the proof's digests, the run's commit content, the canonical host binary, the committed input, the probes' shape and timing) and otherwise rest on the owner's review of the pull request that commits them; nor that the Groth16 trusted setup behind the key is sound (the verifier accepting a proof is compatibility, never soundness); nor that any other hardware proves within the rotation delay; nor that egress stayed refused between the two probes (an attestation of the enforcement, probed at the edges); nor that the archive, the mirrors or the image remain available; nor production readiness (the implementation receipt's PRODUCTION_SP1_BINDING)
